q25. Engine: CEL (Common Expression Language, via `github.com/google/cel-go`) — lives in `internal/filter/` (`engine.go` compiles the CEL expression, `schema.go` defines the field schema/CEL environment, `parser.go` converts the CEL AST into an internal IR of `Condition`/`ValueExpr` nodes, `render.go` renders that IR to SQL).
